vibe: Serious, sovereign-scale, government-facing brand. Editorial gravitas + engineering precision + defense-tech mystique. Avoid generic startup tech looks.

headings.usage: Use for large titles, chapter markers, and 'THE POWER OF INNOVATIONS'. tracking-tight, leading-none. Unapologetic editorial feel.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, overlines, technical data, subsidiary names, buttons. Enhances engineering/defense-tech precision.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: No glassmorphism unless strictly needed for readable sticky navs (use #050505/80 with backdrop-blur-xl). Prefer matte surfaces with 1px borders (border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton using 1px grid borders in data-heavy sections. Use sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to feel industrial and rigid.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Spotlight masking, clipped frames. Real industrial photography treated deliberately with dark duotones or heavy contrast, overlaid with bg-black/40.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle digital noise or grain overlay (pointer-events-none) across the entire application to kill digital flatness.

layouts_and_grids.general: Commit to left-aligned/asymmetric editorial layout. NO centered equal-spaced cards. Generous negative space (py-24, py-32).
layouts_and_grids.the_bento: Use Mode A (The 'Tetris' Grid). 12-column span logic mixing 1x1, 2x1, and tall 1x2 elements to create visual tension.
layouts_and_grids.markers: Numbered manifesto chapters. Enormous '01', '02', '03' using EB Garamond. Positioned asymmetrically to overlap or break the grid.

motion.hero_load: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal of 'THE POWER OF INNOVATIONS' tagline (staggered translate-y with overflow-hidden mask).
motion.parallax: Scroll-linked parallax on the primary hero image or a 3D structural background.
motion.section_reveals: opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(10px)', y: 40 -> opacity: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)', y: 0 with slow easeOut.
motion.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (~40s duration) repeating 'THE POWER OF INNOVATIONS · SINGAPORE · JAKARTA · DELAWARE · DUBAI · BEIJING ·'. Uses react-fast-marquee.
motion.interactions: Hover micro-interactions on subsidiary cards (image zooms inside a clipped frame, border color shift to burnt copper, subtle x-translation on arrow icons).

components.navigation: Sticky nav. Brand left, minimal text links center/right. Language toggle (EN / ID). Solid dark bg or very dark glass. No transparency over images.
components.cards: Cardless UI or completely sharp-edged cards. Left-aligned content. High contrast borders. No soft drop shadows.
components.buttons: Sharp edges, IBM Plex Mono uppercase, 1px border. Hover fills background with accent color.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized inputs. Dark matte background, square corners, focus state adds burnt copper border. Connect to Resend.
components.cms_table: Shadcn tables for Admin News management. Dense, precise grid layout.

pages: Home: Kinetic Hero -> Slow Marquee -> Numbered Manifesto Pillars -> Global Presence Map -> Subsidiaries -> Achievements Ticker -> ISO Strip -> Footer
About: Deep dive into the sovereign-scale holding co history, board room imagery, abstract metal.
Business Pillars: 3 Manifesto Chapters (The Foundation, The Core, The Future) explaining all 13 industries with clipped photography.
Subsidiaries: Asymmetric grid of 8+ companies with hover states.
Global Presence: Visual list/map of locations (Singapore, Indonesia, USA, UAE, China).
Contact: Form with real Resend integration emailed to info@sunjayaasia.com.
instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the exact color hex codes provided (obsidian, burnt copper).
Implement the kinetic line-by-line reveal on the Home Hero exactly as requested (use framer-motion with overflow:hidden wrappers on text lines).
Build out multi-page structure via React Router (Home, About, Pillars, Subsidiaries, Global Presence, News, Contact).
Create the contact form and set up a basic Resend API call in the backend.
Implement the News CMS module (simple CRUD UI).
Ensure dark mode is forced. No toggle required since art direction is firmly committed to Bold-Dark Corporate.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Missing image categories = you use placeholder text, which is FORBIDDEN. Always use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components, modify them for sharp edges and dark themes.
